## Language

Name and, if it has one, the official website.

## File extensions

The extensions causeway should associate with it, and any extensionless file
names such as `Makefile`.

## Comment syntax

- Line comment:
- Block comment start and end:

## Existing grammar

Does a TextMate or Monarch grammar already exist for this language? A link
makes the change far quicker to implement.
